title: Hide completed homework items from Home preview
body:
Home homework cards were showing completed items because the Home section rendered cached homework without applying completion state. This update aligns Home behavior with the homework page by excluding completed tasks before the top-3 preview is built.

- **Behavior change**
  - Home homework preview now omits entries marked as completed.
  - As tasks are completed, remaining pending tasks shift into the 3-item Home slot automatically.

- **Implementation**
  - Updated `lib/feature/home/sections/home_homework.dart` to:
    - read completion state from `HomeworkRemoteDatasource.getCompletedIds()`
    - filter cached homework with that ID set before sorting and truncation

- **Core logic**
  ```dart
  final datasource = sl<HomeworkRemoteDatasource>();
  final completedIds = datasource.getCompletedIds();
  final items = datasource
      .getCachedHomeworks()
      .where((item) => !completedIds.contains(item.id))
      .toList()
    ..sort((a, b) => (a.deadline ?? DateTime(9999))
        .compareTo(b.deadline ?? DateTime(9999)));
  ```
